global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and dark nori seaweed. Fresh green onions crown the noodles, nestled in a white bowl on a wooden table, under soft, natural light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and bubbling, with thin noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.spoon: White ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface, slightly curved bowl, and faint engraved text on handle.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface with visible veins.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows pinkish meat with crispy golden-brown edge and visible fat marbling.
